title: The Crossroads
subtitle: maxCompletableDependents: 1
description: `maxCompletableDependents: 1` caps how many of this quest's dependents may ever complete: the first road walked closes the other for good. Where an exclusive group is a pact between siblings, this is a branch point that closes its own roads — the same choice, said from the other end.
The two roads below are identical in every other respect, because the cap is the only thing this exhibit is about.
